subject: SOC 2 recert: retention addendum & export plan
messages:
From: Daphne Liu <daphne.liu@acme-retail.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 re-cert: scope & log retention questions

Hi Evelyn,

We're kicking off Acme's SOC 2 recertification prep and have a few questions on Redwood's side that will determine scope and the evidence timeline on our end. High level: our audit firm is asking for a 12-13 month window for log retention (auth, admin, request logs) to cover a rolling period that includes our busiest quarter. Our contract currently references a 6-month default window.

Can you confirm: 1) whether Redwood can provide a 13-month retention option (hosted or export), 2) what the timeline and process is for bulk evidence export, and 3) any impact on capacity/throughput during a one-off bulk export?

We're on a renewal cadence with Redwood starting 2028-03-01, so we'd like to settle the retention approach and commercial addendum before that date.

Also, please call out what artifacts you'll provide for the auditor (index, signed attestation of export integrity, MD5 checksums, etc.).

Thanks — happy to get a kickoff call on this week or next.

Best,
Daphne Liu
Security Program Manager
Acme Retail


From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Daphne Liu <daphne.liu@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-retail.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jan 2028 10:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-cert: scope & log retention questions

Hi Daphne / Tom — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Karthik (compliance) and Rishi (infra) and Grace (AM).

Short answer: yes — we can support a 13-month log retention either via a Redwood-hosted archive (paid addendum) or an export to an Acme-managed S3 bucket. Details and tradeoffs below; Karthik and Rishi can comment on the technical approach and timelines.

Proposed next steps: 
- Kickoff call to align scope and auditor artifact requirements (index format, checksums, timestamps). Can you do Wed 1/12 or Fri 1/14?
- Redwood to produce a draft amendment for 13-month retention + estimated cost and seat/capacity uplift.
- Plan a pre-export test (small sample) and a bulk export window the week of Feb 6 if we get sign-off by end of Jan.

I'll capture decisions and the commercial ask in an amendment once the flow is agreed.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[e] evelyn_hart@redwood.com | [m] (415) 555-0182

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Daphne Liu <daphne.liu@acme-retail.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jan 2028 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-cert: scope & log retention questions

Hi all — putting the technical plan on the table so we have a clear picture for the auditor and procurement.

Options (high level):
1) Export to customer-managed S3 (preferred for many customers): we stream monthly/daily exports in compressed ndjson with a manifest and per-file SHA256. We can keep an active rolling 13-month index for quick auditor pulls. Pros: no long-term storage on our bill; you control retention life cycle. Cons: requires an Acme S3 bucket and cross-account role (we'll provide CF template).

2) Redwood hosted archive addendum: we keep an encrypted archive for 13 months and provide a downloadable evidence bundle on request (we produce evidence_index.csv, checksums, and an attestation statement). Pricing is an uplift (see retention_pricing.csv attached). Pros: turnkey for you. Cons: additional monthly hosting fee.

Timeline & process:
- Evidence index template: we will provide an evidence_index.csv within 3 business days of the kickoff. (attached stub)
- Pre-export test: 2–3 days to configure and validate delivery to your S3 or to our test bucket.
- Bulk export window: typically 48–72 hours for a full 13-month export depending on volume; we recommend a dedicated (temporary) burst pool to avoid affecting production latency.
- Artifacts we deliver: evidence_index.csv, per-file SHA256, export_manifest.jsonl, and a signed export_attestation.pdf.

Considerations for auditor: please confirm the expected manifest fields (start/end timestamps, event types included). Our default includes auth events, admin actions, and request logs; we can include additional telemetry on request.

Attachments: retention_pricing.csv (pricing tiers for hosted archive), export_playbook.md (playbook + required AWS role).

Happy to review on the kickoff call.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
[karthik_iyer@redwood.com]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Daphne Liu <daphne.liu@acme-retail.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jan 2028 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-cert: scope & log retention questions

Thanks — a couple of infra specifics from my side to make planning easier.

Log surface and sizing estimate:
- Auth logs: ~120 GB/month
- Admin/audit logs: ~40 GB/month
- Request/ingest logs: ~2.3 TB/month (based on current qps/avg payloads provided in RFP)
- Total (compressed): ~2.5 TB/month -> ~32.5 TB for 13 months.

Export performance & capacity:
- Bulk export of 13 months at a reasonable throughput (500 MB/s sustained) will take ~18 hours of streaming; throttling and retrying brings estimate to 24–48 hours.
- We'll provision a short-lived burst pool (reserved GPUs/IO) during the export window to avoid impacting production. Cost estimate included in retention_pricing.csv.

Runbook & test plan:
- Pre-export canary (export a 7-day slice) to confirm manifests and checksums.
- Export runbook attached (export_runbook.txt) with steps for validating integrity and for resumption if interrupted.
- We'll coordinate exact start times; recommend low-traffic weekend window if you prefer minimal interference.

Risks: concurrent large exports from multiple customers can strain the export pipeline; we'll book the pool for your window once amendment is executed.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Principal SRE | Redwood Inference
[rishi_malhotra@redwood.com]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Daphne Liu <daphne.liu@acme-retail.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jan 2028 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-cert: scope & log retention questions — kickoff & next steps

Hi Daphne / Tom — thanks for the questions and for aligning on the requirements. Quick summary and agreed next steps: 

Summary:
- Redwood supports a 13-month retention by either (A) exporting to an Acme-managed S3 (preferred for custody) or (B) Redwood-hosted archive addendum (turnkey). See retention_pricing.csv for options.
- Artifacts provided: evidence_index.csv, per-file SHA256, export_manifest, and signed export_attestation.pdf.
- Infra will provision a temporary burst pool during the export window to ensure production SLAs are not impacted; Rishi to manage. Estimated export duration: 24–48 hours.

Action items (owner / ETA):
1) Acme: confirm preferred approach (export to S3 vs hosted archive) — please reply by Thu 1/20. (Daphne/Tom)
2) Redwood: draft amendment for 13-month retention + estimated uplift and seat/capacity impact — Evelyn to deliver draft by Fri 1/21.
3) Tech kickoff (30–45 min): Wed 1/20 @ 10:00 AM PT — tentative; we'll send calendar invite once you confirm.
4) Pre-export canary: scheduled when amendment is signed; runbook and sample export to be executed by Redwood and verified by Acme. (Rishi)

Links & artifacts: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2028-R-47 | Draft amendment (DocuSign placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/amendment-ACME-2028 | Evidence folder (drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-acme-soc2-evidence

Attachments referenced earlier (for auditor prep): retention_pricing.csv, export_playbook.md, export_runbook.txt, evidence_index.csv (stub).

If that looks good, please confirm approach by Thursday so we can hit the Feb export window if needed. Thanks — will send the amendment once we have your selection.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[e] evelyn_hart@redwood.com | [m] (415) 555-0182
